spec.scene: A patch of packed golden sand with gentle water ripples glistening at the front edge. At the center rises a stout sandcastle with four corner turrets, encircled by a wide water-filled moat. A tiny stick planted atop the central tower flies a wavy strip of green seaweed. On the left, a kneeling figure in a teal shirt shapes the sand walls. On the right, a smaller figure in red shorts and a blue bucket hat proudly holds a yellow plastic scoop.
spec.title: Ocean Beach Sandcastle
spec.caption: We built an epic castle with a moat and seaweed flag today.
